purpose: Six new scripted conversations for granularity, using existing business fixtures; development diagnostic, not independent held-out validation
grading: Per turn: correct if all requested material facts are right; partial for material omission without false central conclusion; incorrect for wrong central conclusion or action claim. Citation defects tracked separately. No paid judge.

turns.question: For order-2, list the purchased product, quantity and seller.
turns.expected_text: Two Ceramic Mug Sets, sold by Everyday Studio.

turns.question: For that same order, explain why its seller has not received the payout and what must happen before release.
turns.expected_text: Buyer payment is captured. The shipment is pending and payout is held. Delivery must be confirmed, then the 24-hour hold must pass; an operator must request release. There is no recorded payout failure for this order.

turns.question: What exact amount is currently payable to that seller for this order, after the marketplace fee?
turns.expected_text: Everyday Studio is owed INR 1,618.20: gross INR 1,798 less INR 179.80 fee.

turns.question: Investigate the failed payout to Cedar & Co. on order-1. Distinguish the recorded failure from the delivery waiting period.
turns.expected_text: Cedar payout failed due to a simulated provider timeout. Delivery was September 25 at 12:00 UTC; the September 27 12:00 clock is 48 hours later, so the 24-hour hold has passed. An operator may retry; success is not guaranteed.

turns.question: How much is the failed payout amount for that seller on this order?
Which product and how many units on this order belong to that seller?
turns.expected_text: Two Canvas Weekenders from Cedar & Co.

turns.question: Please list purchases associated with Cedar.
turns.expected_text: Ask whether Cedar means seller Cedar & Co. or product Cedar Desk; do not choose silently.

turns.question: The seller Cedar & Co., not the desk product.
turns.expected_text: Order-1 contains two Canvas Weekenders sold by Cedar & Co.; no other Cedar seller orders exist.

turns.question: Within those purchases, show only items that have not been delivered.
turns.expected_text: None; the Cedar items in order-1 have already been delivered.

turns.question: Give the current unpaid seller balance for Cedar & Co. in rupees.
What is that balance now?
turns.expected_text: INR 6,747.30 unpaid, including the newly captured purchase; increase INR 2,249.10 is optional.

turns.question: Explain why the new purchase contributes to money owed even though its shipment is still pending. Is that new payout ready for release?
turns.expected_text: Captured payment creates the seller allocation/payable immediately. That is different from payout eligibility: the new shipment is pending, so it cannot be released until delivery and the 24-hour hold. New item gross INR 2,499, fee INR 249.90, payable INR 2,249.10.

turns.question: For LAMP, give the product, delivery timestamp and current seller payout status.
turns.expected_text: One Desk Lamp, delivered September 27 2026 at 12:00 UTC; payout is held.

turns.question: At the current demo time, can the operator release that payout? Show the elapsed delivery time and the required hold.
turns.expected_text: Yes: September 28 at 12:30 UTC is 24 hours 30 minutes after delivery, exceeding the 24-hour hold. Payout remains held until the operator requests release.

turns.question: What amount would the seller receive for that item, and has it actually been paid yet?
turns.expected_text: INR 1,169.10 is payable. It has not been paid; status is still held.

turns.question: List the products and quantities purchased in order-1.
turns.expected_text: Two Canvas Weekenders and two Desk Lamps.

turns.question: For the Desk Lamp item in that order, who is the seller and what was the unit purchase price?
What is the purchased line total for those lamps, before deducting seller fees?
